repeaters.label: Prospects Hive's strategic B2B approach
shells: • ✓Builds outbound around market understanding, buyer segments and GTM goals
• ✓Uses ICP work, account research and market insight to find the right accounts
• ✓Runs email, LinkedIn and multichannel campaigns in one connected approach
• ✓Uses account context and business signals to make messages relevant
• ✓Feeds campaign insights back into targeting, messaging and execution
• ✓Connects outreach with CRM workflows, follow-ups and reporting

repeaters.label: Typical outbound approach
shells: • ✕Focuses on running campaigns rather than broader GTM planning
• ✕Often works from predefined lists or basic targeting
• ~Runs outbound across channels like email and LinkedIn
• ✕Relies mainly on whatever contact data is available
• ~Optimises based on response and activity data
• ✕Campaigns run separately from internal revenue workflows
